defense_news.title: US Air Force jet engine manufacturing plagued by ‘significant challenges’
defense_news.summary: Jet engine manufacturing is plagued by production delays, quality control issues and material shortages, the U.S. Air Force said.

defense_news.title: Pentagon moves to triple Patriot, quadruple THAAD interceptor production
defense_news.summary: The Pentagon is looking to triple Patriot missile production and quadruple THAAD interceptor production through framework agreements announced Monday.

defense_news.title: Poland readies Ukraine ‘Coalition of Willing’ drills, eyes NATO support for border defense
defense_news.summary: Poland is preparing to host the first military drills for the 'Coalition of the Willing,' a group of nations established to provide support for Ukraine.

defense_news.title: Denmark begins extended military conscription in response to Russia, Trump
defense_news.summary: Around 1,600 military recruits kicked off Denmark's new extended conscription, as the country seeks to reinforce defenses amid Arctic security pressures.

geo_news.title: Türkiye, Katar ve Mısır, İsrail'in Gazze'deki ihlallerini şiddetle kınadı
geo_news.summary: Türkiye, Katar ve Mısır, ortak açıklamayla Gazze'de sivil kayıplara neden olan ve uluslararası hukukun açık ihlalini teşkil eden İsrail ihlallerini şiddetle kınadı.

geo_news.title: Bosna Hersek'ten hareket eden "Filistin Konvoyu" Ankara'ya ulaştı
geo_news.summary: Bosna Hersek'in Srebrenitsa kentinden yola çıkan "Filistin Konvoyu" Ankara'ya geldi.

geo_news.title: MİT Başkanı Kalın, Hamas Siyasi Büro Başkanı Hayye ile görüştü
geo_news.summary: Milli İstihbarat Teşkilatı (MİT) Başkanı İbrahim Kalın, İstanbul'da Hamas Siyasi Büro Başkanı Halil el-Hayye ve beraberindeki heyetle bir araya geldi.
